title_sq: Apartament 2+1 për Shitje pranë tregut Elektrik!
description_sq: Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e dyte te nje godine 3 kateshe e ndetuar ne vitin 2005. Planimetria e prones eshte shume e rregullt dhe e organizuar nga nje sallon ndenje, kuzhine e vecuar, dy dhoma gjumi, nje tualet me dritare si dhe dy ballkonie. Investimi ne apartament eshte i bere se fundmi dhe te gjitha punimet jane cilesore. Orientimi eshte nga Jugu dhe ka ndricimi natyral gjate gjithe dites. Ne cmimin e prones eshte i perfshire dhe nje post parkimi i jashtem
title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale near the Electric market!
description_en: The apartment is located on the second floor of a 3-story building built in 2005. The floor plan of the property is very regular and organized by a living room, separate kitchen, two bedrooms, a bathroom with windows and two balconies. The investment in the apartment was made recently and all the works are of high quality. The orientation is from the South and there is natural lighting throughout the day. An outdoor parking space is included in the price of the property
